provenance.prompt: Purpose: four side-table-life-items-v1 appearances with identical static support-surface function and bottom-centred .18 x .25 x .18m envelope. Reuse pinned original Kenney Food Kit 2.0 cup and soda-bottle mesh topology, actual open cavity/inner bottom, handle and neck/collar/cover assembly. Preserve original PNG bytes, UV, opaque double-sided material and sampler. Bake the measured geometry adaptation once and embed the PNG as an aligned GLB bufferView using the existing company packer pattern. New tissue dispenser has a real slot/cavity and .0002m folded thin paper; the A6 notebook and three supported static pens are explicitly project-authored supplements. Do not replace original gradients with per-face colors, invent liquid/glass/opening states or force buried original joints into independent closed shells. Read actual source/index geometry, include PNG/UV identity and independent finite data/geometry checks. Budget 2500 triangles/32 meshes/four materials. Browser native image decode, restoration, image ownership and user appearance need separate evidence. Design: Adapt the complete original unbranded 100-triangle beverage bottle. Preserve the actual body/collar/cover assembly and palette; no visible liquid or cap animation.
limitations: Static source adaptation and original supplements. No hand, fluid, opening or paper extraction state.
CPU uses a texture placeholder solely for geometry parsing. Native image decoding, UV/appearance, image ownership, transactions and closed-process restoration need real-browser evidence.
